mo_ta_cong_viec:
About the position
As a new initiative, Money Forward has begun considering the provision of BaaS/digital banking in collaboration with Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group and Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation.
We are currently seeking an Engineering Manager.
This role expects a strong security mindset, with a clear understanding of data privacy, credential protection, device security, and the responsible use of corporate systems, tools, and accounts.
 
Responsibilities
Lead the team to develop the digital bank system from scratch
Overall project management including planning, tracking, risk management, stakeholder management, quality assurance etc.
Build and manage development teams across three countries: Japan, India, and Vietnam
Build & tracking engineering process follow Scrum/Agile framework
Taking responsibility for Scrum Master of the team
Regularly communicate with development team members to resolve technical issues, manage progress, and ensure quality
Participate in system design, contribute to system architecture, and handle integrations with third parties.
Review code, provide insights, and set up coding standards for the project.
Design system operations and maintenance with a view from the development stage to post-release
After release, efficiently and safely conduct additional system development, operations, and maintenance
Ensure regular reports to management
yeu_cau:
Requirements / Qualifications
Over 10 years of development experience and more than 3 years of engineering management experience / project management
Practical experience with Scrum/Agile framework
Practical experience leading a development team of 30 or more members
Experience in backend system development using Java or similar
Experience in developing micro-services applications in Cloud environment
Practical experience related to frontend technologies such as React or NodeJS
Experience with authentication and authorization technologies like OAuth 2.0, OIDC
Experience in system development and operation using cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.)
Strong problem-solving skills and leadership
Excellent English communication skill
 
Nice to haves
While not specifically required, tell us if you have any of the following.
Experience in developing, operating, and maintaining mission-critical business systems in financial institutions (especially core banking systems)
Knowledge and experience in collaboration with financial institutions and regulatory compliance (experience interacting with the Financial Services Agency is a plus)
Project experience using Mambu
Experience implementing continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD)
Experience in building teams and operational flows based on DevOps culture
Experience in AI development or development using AI tools
